goal: Relevant retail teams open the ungated demo and choose to watch it.

available_site_measures: Landing-page browser sessions with campaign UTMs
Sessions with at least 90 percent video coverage
measurement.sales_outcome: Relevant retail inquiries verified in the actual inbox, recorded separately.
measurement.limitation: A page request, unique IP, UTM tag or player event alone does not verify a human buyer.
measurement.review_rule_note: Operator guardrails, not industry benchmarks or automated account rules. A small test cannot prove absence of demand.

google.location_option: Presence: People in or regularly in your targeted locations

budget.instruction: Create a new paused Search campaign with a campaign-total budget in Google Ads. Do not enter 400 into an Editor Budget or Daily budget column.

bidding.instruction: Review current US keyword forecasts in Keyword Planner and choose an affordable maximum CPC bid limit before activation. No CPC estimate is supplied or implied.

recommended_first_activation.instruction: After launch review, enable only the initial ad group, its exact-match keywords and its RSA. Keep phrase keywords and reserve groups paused until search-term quality and playback are checked.

Free template download; does not exclude free demos
A specifically free software request; does not exclude free-demo modifiers

google.exclusion_reason: Existing systems and free demos can be part of a qualified buying query. Add narrowly defined negatives from actual search terms instead of blocking these words wholesale.

budget.date_rule: Bulk-template start and end dates are 00:00 UTC; end date is exclusive.

bidding.reason: No measured ChatGPT campaign CPC exists yet. Intelligent bidding pursues the Clicks objective within the selected budget without inventing a price target.
bidding.current_rule: Target CPC is an average cost goal, not a per-click ceiling. New click campaigns have Target CPC from November 9, 2026. From November 18, legacy API fields used for new campaigns or bid-type changes select target bidding.
